name: Craftable Horse Armour & Saddle [CHA&S]
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: Ewy
description: Adds crafting recipes for horse armour and saddles.

softOff.why: data pack files (recipes, loot, tags) stay

works: Three crafting recipes (namespace chas) for iron, golden and diamond horse armour from a helmet, leggings, white wool and ingots or gems.
note: Not yet: Every recipe uses one of Fabric's convention tags (#c:ingots/iron, #c:ingots/gold, #c:gems/diamond), which the game's own data doesn't have: if no loaded mod fills them, the game may refuse the recipes.
